human_decision.amendment_reason: The human explicitly reaffirms independent supplier x action_class verdicts while both classes remain mandatory reporting units. Delete and occupied-swap differ in semantics, prevalence, incumbent features, and downstream realizers; requiring a cross-class conjunction would incorrectly let representation irrelevance to one class veto genuine separation in the other. No class-local threshold is relaxed.
human_decision.weight_registration_reason: Both previous launches were operationally INVALID before supplier outcomes. V3 binds the exact official checkpoint, private dataset version, and tensor-only loader without changing the representation or scientific gate.
human_decision.third_launch_override: Exactly one additional bounded launch is authorized because v1 and v2 emitted no scientific outcome; this does not waive any metric, integrity, or downstream gate.

frozen_population.description: Exact Phase-1 compiler-valid fit-only 44b6 delete and occupied-swap action populations already banked without a v1/v2 scientific outcome.
frozen_population.labels: Exact single-action delta S(G); beneficial iff delta S(G)>0, harmful otherwise.
frozen_population.folds: Five frozen identity-grouped OOF folds inside the fit-only population.

arms_and_execution_order.B0: Incumbent frozen features only. Emit and hash a complete both-class B0 artifact before A1 or A0 evaluation starts.
arms_and_execution_order.A1: Incumbent frozen features plus the true eight CELLECT endpoint-pair descriptors derived from the authenticated 64-D embeddings.
arms_and_execution_order.A0: The capacity-matched incumbent plus CELLECT descriptors after deterministic within-frame node-consistent embedding permutation.
arms_and_execution_order.probe: Class-balanced standardized ridge least-squares binary rank probe, lambda 0.01, deterministic float64.

metrics.auc: Beneficial-versus-harmful ROC AUC with average ranks for ties.
metrics.retention: Beneficial-action retention at the exact frozen CG0 per-video harmful-action budget.
metrics.per_video_budget_tie_rule: Score-tied blocks are selected atomically only when the full block stays within the video budget.

pass_gate.conjunction_within_unit: Every condition must pass in every one of five held OOF folds.

verdict_semantics.PASS: For that CELLECT supplier x action_class only, unlock a newly frozen 44b6 graph-gate preregistration for human review. Do not execute the graph or promote a tier.
verdict_semantics.FAIL: Park that CELLECT supplier x action_class instantiation PARK-C and prohibit its full-pool GPU cache spend. Report the other class independently.
verdict_semantics.INVALID: Any population, fold, label, baseline, feature, metric, provenance, resource, ordering, or integrity contract violation produces no scientific verdict for the affected unit.
verdict_semantics.shared_failure_rule: A shared checkpoint, license, loader, representation, leakage, or integrity failure invalidates both class evaluations.

compute_authorization.scope: Only exact frozen 44b6 separation-population endpoint features; never a full-pool cache.
